messages:
Maya: Quick micro-poll — we need a friendly nickname for the tiny internal LLM (codename `pixie`). Vote with emoji in-thread or just reply with your pick.
Options:
• :cat: Poppy
• :owl: Hawke
• :fox: Fennec
• :robot: Gizmo

Jordan: :cat: Poppy from me. short + friendly.

Priya: :fox: Fennec — feels clever and small.

Luis: :robot: Gizmo for irony.

Erin: adding :heart: for Poppy (can't resist a cat).

Sam: can we have an honorable mention? `Sprout` — for the tiniest model energy.

Alex: vote split between Poppy and Fennec. If we're naming infra things after animals we should make a tiny sticker 😄

Maya: @poll-bot, tally reactions? :eyes:

poll-bot: Poll closed automatically after 30m. Results: Poppy 3, Fennec 2, Gizmo 1, Sprout (write-ins) 1. Poppy wins :tada:

Jordan: congrats Poppy. Sticker design contest when? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Priya: I call dibs on the Poppy emoji for our docs header.

Luis: can we also have a `pixie` tag mapped to Poppy in our model registry? small request.

Maya: noted. I'll add the alias mapping — thanks everyone for the quick votes! :sparkles:
